description: Client-side Minecraft 26.1 Fabric mod that puts name tags above every entity — item counts for drops, armor/health/status effects for players — fully configurable via Mod Menu (Cloth Config).

mods.name: Item Tag
mods.description:
Shows name tags above all entities in range, with item names and stack counts for dropped items. Filter which entity types are tagged in the Mod Menu config screen.

在渲染范围内为所有实体头顶显示名字，掉落物额外显示物品名称与数量，可在 Mod Menu 配置界面中筛选显示类别。

releases.notes:
Initial release for Minecraft 26.1.

- Name tags above all entities in render range (vanilla-style, visible through walls)
- Dropped items: item name + stack count (`Diamond ×64`)
- Players: armor & held item icons beside the player, health bar, status effects with durations
- Mob health display
- Modern config screen via Mod Menu (Cloth Config): 18 individual toggles, 8–128 block tag range, entity-ID blacklist
- English & Chinese localization

**Requires:** Fabric Loader ≥ 0.20.1, Fabric API, Cloth Config, Mod Menu, Java 25. Drop the jar into `.minecraft/mods/` together with the companion mods.
